title: The War between Amaziah and Joash and the Fall of Amaziah
description: Amaziah challenges the king of Israel, Joash, to battle. Joash responds with the parable of the thistle and the cedar, but Amaziah refuses to listen. The armies meet at Beth-Shemesh, where Judah is defeated and Amaziah taken captive. Joash tears down part of Jerusalem's wall, takes gold, silver, and hostages, and returns to Samaria. Later, a conspiracy is plotted against Amaziah; he flees to Lachish but is overtaken and killed there.
